heading: Crash diagnostics
description: Self-reported reset reasons and pre-freeze heap state, newest first.
empty: No crash reports received from this reader yet.
coredumpPendingHint: The reader keeps its {{size}} coredump and uploads it after it reconnects. If this stays pending after the reader has reconnected, the dump was probably lost.
coredumpRejectedHint: The reader announced a {{size}} coredump that the server refused because it is too large or its details are invalid. The reader keeps it in flash; read it out over USB if you need it.
coredumpRejectedHintNoSize: The reader announced a coredump that the server refused because its details are invalid. The reader keeps it in flash; read it out over USB if you need it.
orphanCoredumpHint: The reader found this coredump in its flash without the matching crash record, so the reset reason, heap values and crash firmware are unknown. The build id and backtrace come from the dump itself.
symbolicationUnavailableHint: The server toolchain or matching firmware ELF was not available, so this coredump could not be symbolized. Download the raw coredump for offline analysis.
